facts.label: Passivo no presente (regras)
facts.sub: Horários: is served at eight. Regras: is not allowed. Plural: are kept. Pergunta: Are guests allowed to eat here?

facts.label: É servido
facts.sub: Use is served para refeições. Dinner is served at eight. Breakfast is served from seven to ten. Para dizer a hora, use at; para período, use from…to.

facts.label: É fechado
facts.sub: Use is closed para horário de fechamento. The pool is closed at nine. O bar is open até certa hora e is closed depois. Pessoas não aparecem na frase.

facts.label: É permitido
facts.sub: Use is allowed e is not allowed para regras. Food is not allowed near the computers. Guests are allowed to eat in the lobby. Depois de allowed vem to + verbo.

facts.label: São guardados
facts.sub: Use are kept para coisas que ficam guardadas. The bags are kept at the front desk for free. For free quer dizer “de graça”.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: “Dinner is served at eight” is a present passive.
“Food is not allowed” tells us a rule.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: “Dinner is served at eight” is a present passive. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “The doors is opened”. → Falso (Plural: are opened.)
“Food is not allowed” tells us a rule. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 2/2

pages.title: A first day at a Brisbane hotel · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a warm evening in a hotel in Brisbane. Guests walk through the lobby with their bags. Bree works at the desk, and Sara is her new coworker. It is Sara’s first day, so she has many questions. She wants to learn the times and the rules. Bree is happy to explain everything.

“Sara, dinner is served at eight in the dining room.” says Bree. “Good. Is breakfast served in the same place?” says Sara. “Yes, it is served from seven to ten. The doors are opened at seven.” says Bree.
